message.content:
**Uno – Quick Overview** | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards (4 colors × 19 cards each + 8 special cards) | | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points across multiple rounds | | **Setup** | Shuffle → Deal 7 cards to each player → Place remaining cards face‑down as draw pile; flip top card to start discard pile | | **Turn Actions** | 1️⃣ Play a matching card (color or number) or a special card
2️⃣ If no playable card, draw one from draw pile
3️⃣ If drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses turn
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two and skips
• **Wild** – choose new color
• **Wild Draw Four** – choose new color & next player draws four (must be played only if you have no other legal move) | | **Winning a Round** | First player to get rid of all cards scores points based on remaining cards in opponents’ hands (number cards = face value, special cards = 20–50 points). | | **Scoring** | Keep a running total; first to reach 500 wins the game. | **Key Rules** * You must match either the color or the number/symbol of the top discard card. * Wild cards let you change the current color at any time. * A “Draw Two” or “Wild Draw Four” can be stacked: the next player may add another of the same type instead of drawing. * If you cannot play after drawing, your turn ends. That’s the core of Uno—fast, colorful, and full of strategy!
